_doc: Hand corrections. Keys are fabric ids (brand::pattern::colour, the same id
the site uses in /fabrics/<id> and /design?fabric=<id>). Every field is
optional; whatever you set here wins over the rule table and survives a
rebuild. Delete an entry to hand it back to the rules.

alendel::palermo::mojito._why: Rainbow awning stripe. The 96px crop the metrics run on blurs the stripes into one muted green, so no photo rule can see it — this is what the overrides file is for.

carole::hobbs::ginger._why: Pale apricot solid. Numerically identical (L84 C15 h74) to a tan motif printed on a cream ground, which must stay Beige — no photo rule can separate the two, so this one is set by hand.
